# SurfaceTrail v28 fixture

`surface-trail-v28.wefx` is a 614-byte authored effect exported by the Stage 6
browser suite on 2026-10-19 before the separately developed FX composition work
advanced the shared archive writer to v29. It contains one World SurfaceTrail
definition: 128 points, six-second lifetime, .05 m sampling, 2 m break distance,
.5 m texture repeat and .02 m normal offset, with the preset width/colour curves.
It contains no runtime instances or external files. The focused native suite loads
this actual older envelope to check compatibility with the current reader.
